name: 1 non-short-circuit boolean guard
expectedWrongForm: if Rec.Get(x) and (Rec.Field > 0) - AL does not short-circuit, so the second operand runs on a failed Get
requirement: Table "CG P Setup" has a Code[20] primary key "Code" and an Integer field Threshold. Write a codeunit procedure IsOverThreshold(SetupCode: Code[20]; Value: Integer): Boolean that returns true only when a setup row with that code exists AND Value exceeds its Threshold. It must not raise an error when no such setup row exists.

name: 2 List assignment aliasing
expectedWrongForm: Copy := Original then modifying Copy, which mutates the caller's list because List is a reference type
requirement: Write a codeunit procedure WithoutBlanks(Source: List of [Text]) that returns a new List of [Text] containing the non-blank entries of Source. The caller's Source list must be completely unchanged when the procedure returns.

name: 3 FindFirst under a non-primary current key
expectedWrongForm: relying on FindFirst after SetCurrentKey to still return the lowest primary key
requirement: Table "CG P Entry" has an Integer primary key "Entry No." and fields "Posting Date" (Date) and Amount (Decimal). Write a codeunit procedure OldestEntryNo(): Integer that returns the "Entry No." of the entry with the earliest Posting Date, breaking ties by the lowest Entry No.

name: 4 write inside a failing TryFunction
expectedWrongForm: assuming a database write made inside a [TryFunction] that then errors is rolled back
requirement: Write a codeunit with a procedure ImportLine(Payload: Text) that records an audit row in table "CG P Audit" saying an import was attempted, then parses Payload and inserts a "CG P Line". If parsing fails the procedure must not surface the error to the caller, and NO "CG P Line" may exist for that payload, but the audit row must remain.

name: 5 same-session lost update
expectedWrongForm: holding two Record variables on the same row and writing both, so the second Modify overwrites the first
requirement: Write a codeunit procedure ApplyBoth(EntryNo: Integer) that adds 10 to field Amount of "CG P Entry" and, separately, sets its Status field to Posted. Both changes must be present on the stored row afterwards.

name: 6 Text truncation on assignment
expectedWrongForm: assigning a longer Text to a Text[50] field without CopyStr, which errors at runtime rather than truncating
requirement: Table "CG P Note" has a Text[50] field Summary. Write a codeunit procedure StoreSummary(EntryNo: Integer; FullText: Text) that stores the first 50 characters of FullText in Summary. It must never raise a length error however long FullText is.

name: 7 deleting while iterating
expectedWrongForm: Delete() inside a FindSet/Next loop, which skips rows because the cursor advances from a deleted position
requirement: Write a codeunit procedure PurgeZeroLines(DocumentNo: Code[20]) that deletes every "CG P Line" on the given document whose Quantity is zero. Every such line must be gone when it returns, and no other line may be deleted.

name: 8 filtering on a FlowField
expectedWrongForm: SetRange on a FlowField without SetAutoCalcFields, which filters on an uncalculated zero
requirement: Table "CG P Customer" has a FlowField Balance summing "CG P Entry".Amount for that customer. Write a codeunit procedure CountCustomersInDebt(): Integer returning how many customers have a Balance greater than zero.
